pages.title: Touken Danshi Guide
pages.text: Touken Danshi can be summoned using their respective summoning items by right-clicking on a block. Their summoning items cannot currently be crafted and can only be found in chests within various naturally generated structures.$(br2)Touken Danshi possess a 25-slot inventory, can wear player armor and benefit from its effects, and can additionally equip mod-exclusive gear: omamori. Different omamori provide varying levels of health and attack damage bonuses.$(br2)For more details, see the following Touken Danshi GUI panel.$(br2)Touken Danshi cannot use or equip shields.

pages.title: Touken Danshi GUI Showcase
pages.text: The four slots to the left of the entity render are the armor slots. The three slots at the very top are the omamori slots.

pages.title: Touken Danshi Guide
pages.text: Touken Danshi can be summoned using their respective summoning items by right-clicking on a block. Their summoning items cannot currently be crafted and can only be found in chests within various naturally generated structures.$(br2)Touken Danshi possess a 25-slot inventory, can wear player armor and benefit from its effects, and can additionally equip mod-exclusive gear: omamori. Different omamori provide varying levels of health and attack damage bonuses.$(br2)For more details, see the following Touken Danshi GUI panel.$(br2)Touken Danshi cannot use or equip shields.

pages.title: Touken Danshi: Tantou
pages.text: Possesses the lowest health among all blade types, with lower damage, but the fastest movement and attack speed.$(br2)Their detection range and attack power receive a significant bonus at night.

pages.title: Touken Danshi: Wakizashi
pages.text: Health is relatively low among all blade types, with average damage, but relatively fast movement and attack speed.$(br2)Detection range and attack power receive a moderate bonus at night.

pages.title: Touken Danshi: Uchigatana
pages.text: Health is at a medium level, with average damage, movement speed, and attack speed.$(br2)Detection range and attack power receive a slight night battle bonus.

pages.title: Touken Danshi: Tachi
pages.text: Higher health and damage, but slower movement and attack speed.$(br2)Tachi are not suited for night battle, as their detection range and attack power are greatly reduced at night.

pages.title: Touken Danshi: Ootachi
pages.text: High health and damage, capable of dealing splash area-of-effect damage, but extremely slow movement and attack speed.$(br2)Ootachi are not suited for night battle, as their detection range and attack power are severely reduced at night.

pages.title: Touken Danshi: Naginata
pages.text: High health and damage, capable of performing wide-area full damage attacks. Slower movement and attack speed.$(br2)Naginata are not suited for night battle, as their detection range and attack power are greatly reduced at night.

pages.title: Touken Danshi: Yari
pages.text: Relatively high health and high damage, capable of dealing true damage that ignores armor and enchantments, with fast movement and attack speed.$(br2)The detection range and attack power of Yari are slightly reduced at night.

pages.title: Touken Danshi: Tsurugi
pages.text: Relatively high health and damage, capable of using unique skills, with average movement and attack speed.$(br2)Certain Tsurugi-type Touken Danshi can effectively counter enemy Kiwame Yari / High-Speed Yari.
